newsitem.title: RUSSIA: FORECAST- Russia Dec inflation seen at 1.0-1.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST- Russia Dec inflation seen at 1.0-1.2 pct.

text.p: Russian consumer inflation in December will slow to 1.0-1.2 percent after 1.9 percent in November, the chairman of the State Statistics Committee said on Monday.
"We expected about two percent inflation (in December) but the latest data shows it at about one, a maximum of 1.2 percent," Yury Yurkov told a news conference.
Consumer prices rose by 3.2 percent in December 1995.
Yurkov repeated previous forecasts that inflation for the year ending in December would be 22 percent, after 131 percent a year earlier.
